title: Gateway crashes when a provider omits finish_reason (+ write regression test)
bug_report:
Some OpenAI-compatible providers omit `finish_reason` from a response choice. When that happens, `traceforge.agent.gateway.chat(...)` crashes while building its `ModelResponse` with `AttributeError: ... object has no attribute 'finish_reason'`, instead of returning a response (the reply content and tool calls were perfectly fine). Observed via a provider whose JSON choice has only `index` and `message`; several tests in the existing gateway test file also fail with the same AttributeError.

Additional deliverable for this task: besides finding the root cause and fixing it, write your OWN regression test in a NEW file `backend/tests/agent/test_finish_reason_regression.py`. It must fail on the buggy code and pass once the bug is fixed.
ask: diagnose, fix, and write a regression test
